name: hubot-command-mapper
description: Helps with mapping tools and commands to Hubot.

scripts.test: npm run build:test && node --test --test-timeout=10000 ".test-build/test/**/*.spec.mjs" && npm run test:exports
scripts.build:test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.test-build', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc
scripts.publish-patch: npm run build && npm test && npm version patch && npm publish
scripts.publish-minor: npm run build && npm test && npm version minor && npm publish
scripts.publish-major: npm run build && npm test && npm version major && npm publish

author: Kees C. Bakker
